masked.business_two_sentences: This company develops drug candidates for depression, migraine, narcolepsy and Alzheimer's-related agitation and has no FDA-approved products yet. It funds itself from cash reserves and equity financing while its lead depression combination drug awaits an anticipated regulatory filing [c6].

transparent.business_two_sentences: Axsome Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing novel therapies for central nervous system disorders, including major depressive disorder, migraine, narcolepsy and Alzheimer's disease agitation. It has no FDA-approved products and funds operations from cash reserves and equity financing while its lead drug, AXS-05, awaits an anticipated NDA filing [c6].

what_changed.fact: AXS-05 met its primary endpoint versus placebo in the pivotal Phase 3 GEMINI trial for major depressive disorder [c1].
what_changed.relationship_to_business: GEMINI is the second positive well-controlled trial of Axsome's lead drug candidate and is the trigger for the company's planned NDA filing.

what_changed.fact: Q3 cash was $43.6 million, down from $53.8 million at the end of Q2 2019; five other ongoing clinical trials had updated expected readout windows [c9][c8].
what_changed.relationship_to_business: Sets the pre-catalyst cash position and lists near-term milestones (STRIDE-1, ADVANCE-1, two AXS-07 trials, AXS-12) that remain outstanding.

what_changed.fact: The FDA granted AXS-05 Breakthrough Therapy designation for major depressive disorder [c6].
what_changed.relationship_to_business: This designation is intended to speed FDA interaction for drugs showing preliminary evidence of substantial improvement over available therapy, and underlies the company's expectation for the pace of an eventual NDA review.

programs.drug_mechanism: AXS-05: a combination tablet of dextromethorphan (an NMDA-receptor blocker, a mechanism different from standard antidepressants) and bupropion (which raises dextromethorphan's blood levels); taken by mouth.
programs.ownership: Wholly owned by Axsome; worldwide rights
programs.trial_id: GEMINI (company study name; ClinicalTrials.gov identifier not independently verified before cutoff, see missing_data)
programs.design: Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, multicenter, U.S. trial [c2].
programs.primary_endpoint: Change from baseline in MADRS total score (a 10-item clinician-rated depression severity scale) at Week 6
programs.secondary_endpoints: MADRS change at Weeks 1-2, remission, response, CGI-I/CGI-S, PGI-I, MADRS-6, Sheehan Disability Scale, quality of life (Q-LES-Q-SF), safety
programs.latest_evidence: Met primary endpoint: MADRS reduction 16.6 vs 11.9 points (p=0.002); all secondary endpoints significant at Week 6; effect visible from Week 1 [c1][c3][c4]
programs.safety: Well tolerated; dizziness, nausea, headache, diarrhea, somnolence, dry mouth most common; 1 unrelated SAE; no psychotomimetic effects or weight gain [c5]
programs.management_says_vs_regulator: Management says GEMINI plus the earlier ASCEND trial are sufficient to support an NDA submission and that AXS-05 holds FDA Breakthrough Therapy designation for MDD; no public FDA statement committing to approval is in this packet -- designation and future NDA acceptance/review are separate events [c6].
programs.next_milestone: NDA filing anticipated second half of 2020 (announced 2019-12-16) [c6]
programs.economic_relevance: No approved products or product sales exist; AXS-05 in MDD is the company's most advanced program and the basis for the cutoff-date news.

programs.drug_mechanism: Same AXS-05 combination as above, in patients who failed two or more prior antidepressant treatments
programs.design: Not detailed in the cutoff-eligible sources beyond 'Phase 3 trial'
programs.population: Adults with MDD who failed two or more antidepressant therapies
programs.latest_evidence: No readout yet; FDA Fast Track designation granted for this indication [c7]
programs.management_says_vs_regulator: Management states topline results are expected Q1 2020; this is a company timing estimate, not a regulator statement [c8]
programs.next_milestone: Topline results expected first quarter of 2020 (announced 2019-11-07) [c8]
programs.economic_relevance: Second value driver behind the MDD indication for the same drug; no separate economics disclosed

programs.drug_mechanism: Same AXS-05 combination, tested in agitation associated with Alzheimer's disease
programs.design: Phase 2/3; the bupropion-monotherapy comparison arm was proposed to be discontinued on an independent data monitoring committee recommendation, with FDA agreement to that change not yet confirmed as of the cutoff [c12]
programs.population: Patients with Alzheimer's disease and agitation
programs.latest_evidence: No readout yet; FDA Fast Track designation granted for this indication [c7]
programs.safety: A trial-design change (dropping the bupropion-monotherapy arm) was proposed on safety/data-monitoring grounds; no new efficacy or safety readout [c12]
programs.management_says_vs_regulator: Company disclosure flags that FDA's agreement to the arm change is a risk factor, i.e. not yet a confirmed regulatory position [c12]
programs.next_milestone: Topline data expected first half of 2020 (announced 2019-11-07) [c8]
programs.economic_relevance: Third indication for the same lead compound; no separate economics disclosed

programs.drug_mechanism: AXS-07: a combination of meloxicam (an anti-inflammatory) and rizatriptan (a triptan used for migraine), using Axsome's metabolic-inhibition technology
programs.phase: Phase 3, two trials ongoing (not yet read out)
programs.design: Phase 3 trials; design details beyond 'Phase 3' not in eligible sources

programs.next_milestone: MOMENTUM topline expected Q4 2019; INTERCEPT topline expected Q1 2020 (announced 2019-11-07) [c8]
programs.economic_relevance: Company's second lead program outside CNS/depression; targeted second potential NDA filing in H2 2020 alongside AXS-05 for MDD [c8]

unresolved_questions: Will the FDA accept the ASCEND-plus-GEMINI package as sufficient support for an AXS-05 NDA in MDD without further studies?
Will the pending STRIDE-1, ADVANCE-1, AXS-07 and AXS-12 readouts due over the next two quarters replicate GEMINI's pattern or add new risk?
Is the current cash position, plus management's plan not to raise new equity before its Phase 3 readouts, enough to fund operations through the anticipated NDA filing?

own: GEMINI is the second positive well-controlled Phase 3 trial of AXS-05 in MDD, following ASCEND, which the company says is sufficient to support an NDA filing anticipated in the second half of 2020 [c1][c6].
AXS-05 already holds FDA Breakthrough Therapy designation for MDD, granted in March 2019, a status meant to speed agency interaction [c6].

The effect was consistent and rapid: statistically significant improvement over placebo appeared at Week 1 and was significant on every measured secondary endpoint at Week 6, with a tolerability profile that included no reported psychotomimetic effects or weight gain [c3][c4][c5].

Management states it does not anticipate needing new equity financing before its Phase 3 readouts, and four more pivotal or Phase 2 readouts (STRIDE-1, ADVANCE-1, AXS-07 x2, AXS-12) are expected within the next two quarters, giving several near-term catalysts beyond MDD alone [c9][c8].
flat: AXS-05 remains unapproved; no NDA has been filed and no FDA-approved product exists to generate revenue yet [c6].

Cash fell to $43.6 million at September 30, 2019 from $53.8 million three months earlier, and this packet's own scenario calculation implies roughly 4.5 quarters of funding at the recent burn rate -- shorter than management's own 'into Q2 2021' estimate [c9][c11c].
Four additional trial readouts are due within about two quarters, each an independent event with its own binary risk in either direction [c8].
short: The company's own risk disclosure flags that FDA agreement to a mid-trial design change in ADVANCE-1 (dropping the bupropion-monotherapy arm on a data monitoring committee's recommendation) was not yet confirmed as of the filing -- a specific, disclosed source of regulatory uncertainty in one pipeline program [c12].

Net cash used in operating activities over the first nine months of 2019 was about $28.8 million against a cash balance built mainly through financing activities ($58.5 million raised over the same nine months), underscoring dependence on continued capital-markets access for a pre-revenue company [c10].

Management's characterization that the two-trial package 'is sufficient to support submission' of an NDA is the company's own assessment; no public FDA statement committing to accept or approve on that basis is present in this packet [c6].
